example_prompt: Create a checkout session for a customer to pay 100 EUR for an order.

amount.description: Amount, a whole positive number for currencies without minor units (5000 for 5 000 XOF).

allOf.description: ISO 4217 code. Accepted currencies are listed in the introduction. Amounts are whole numbers for currencies without minor units (XOF, XAF, GNF, UGX, RWF, CDF, MGA, KMF, DJF, BIF).

metadata.description: Your own free-form data, returned in webhooks. Cartflox adds `source` (`checkout_session`, `widget`, `payment_link`...) and, when relevant, `description`, `success_url`, `cancel_url` and `idempotencyKey`.

cancel_url.description: Return address when the customer gives up.

success_url.description: Return address after a successful payment.

customer_name.description: Customer name, pre-filled on the payment page.

merchant_logo.description: `https` address of a logo shown instead of the workspace logo (PNG, JPG or SVG). Non-https values are ignored.

merchant_name.description: Name shown at the top of the payment page instead of the workspace name (60 characters at most). Useful to platforms collecting for several brands.

customer_phone.description: Phone number in E.164 international format (`+2250700000000`), pre-filled for Mobile Money.

id.description: Session identifier. Keep it to follow the payment.

url.description: Hosted payment page. Redirect your customer here.

amount.description: Amount the payer is asked for. On a Connect workspace with "fees charged to the customer", it is the requested amount plus the gateway fee.

status.description: `pending` at creation. On an idempotent replay, the current status in lower case.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: The `merchant_logo` field only accepts HTTPS URLs. If a non-HTTPS URL is provided, it will be ignored.
When specifying `amount` for currencies without minor units (XOF, XAF, GNF, UGX, RWF, CDF, MGA, KMF, DJF, BIF), ensure it is a whole positive number. For example, 5000 for 5 000 XOF.

spans: Amount, a whole positive number for currencies without minor units (5000 for 5 000 XOF).
